subject: Combined sequence length exceeds maximum-Parallel Implementation

messages.author: 0bdcec2dd0e167f3
messages.subject: Combined sequence length exceeds maximum-Parallel Implementation
parts:
Hello, 

I have a big fastq file of sequences(approximately 8000 sequences). I would like to do a motif discovery using MEME suit web tool. I am getting this error: 
"Combined sequence length exceeds maximum"
Apparently, this is a common error for analysis of big data. I tried to get my answer in Q&A page. As I noticed we need to implement our analysis through parallel computing. There is an article that refers us to http://www.sdsc.edu/CompSci/Biomed/MEME for such motif discovery analysis. unfortunately I can not reach the referred page on their server and I get error of "404: File Not Found".

I would appreciate if you guide me how can I do my motif discovery analysis. 

Best,
